title: Q 15:9 textual-preservation construction corpus-uniqueness
Q15_9_text: إنا نحن نزلنا الذكر وإنا له لحافظون

lahu_la-ḥāfiẓūn_referent_classification.Q9:112: limits of God (al-ḥudūd Allāh) — NOT revealed text
lahu_la-ḥāfiẓūn_referent_classification.Q12:12: Yūsuf (Joseph) — NOT revealed text; in fraternal-protection language (false-guarantee)
lahu_la-ḥāfiẓūn_referent_classification.Q15:9: al-dhikr (the Reminder, the revealed Qurʾān) — IS revealed text

interpretation: Q 15:9 is the corpus-UNIQUE verse joining (a) naḥnu nazzalnā + (b) nazzalnā al-dhikr + (c) lahu la-ḥāfiẓūn. While each of the 3 sub-constructions appears separately in other verses, only Q 15:9 has all three combined AND has the revealed-text referent for (c). This is the empirical anchor for al-Bāqillānī's iʿjāz-of-preservation tradition.
